Italian Restaurant Bringing Pizza, Fresh Pasta and Panuozzo to North Jersey

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

A new Italian restaurant specializing in pizza, fresh pasta and panuozzo has come to North Jersey.

Chianti has opened at 57 Route 23 in Wayne, with the restaurant currently targeting an October opening.

The menu is centered around Italian classics, including a selection of pizzas and housemade pasta alongside panuozzo, the Italian sandwich traditionally made using pizza dough.

sponsored

Chianti is describing its focus as “authentic Italian flavors, made fresh daily,” with additional menu offerings including salads, sides and desserts.
